description: Return the OSC routes a device exposes: declarative commands (OSC paths it accepts), cc/nrpn params, sysex params, named note triggers (drum sounds), and reply patterns. Use this to discover what a device can do.

user_id.description: Your anonymous SynthHub id, if you kept it from an earlier session (see the server instructions). Optional.

name: list_routes

cc_params.description: CC / NRPN parameters, each mapped to an OSC address. Every entry carries an 'expects' field (continuous/switch/momentary/trigger/clock/discrete) describing the device-side nature of the control — informative only, the signal realization is the caller's concern.

commands.description: Declarative OSC paths the device accepts, with typed args and mode (forward/frame).

params.description: SysEx parameters, each mapped to an OSC address. Each entry carries an 'expects' field — see cc_params.

replies.description: Reply patterns the device emits back onto the OSC surface.

triggers.description: Named note-triggered sounds (drum machines, samplers). Send '<address> [velocity] [note] [channel]' to fire a Note On; 'note' is required when the entry has no natural note.
